text: {"class": "fixable", "chokepoint": [], "floor_ms": 0, "L_delta": 0, "rationale": "The contract freezes nothing, so no certificate is possible. GNU's ~1.1 ms is essentially start-up: under LC_ALL=C, -m equals the byte count, which GNU can take from fstat. uutils can add the same shortcut instead of reading 32 MiB. It can also cut start-up overhead of a 19 MB dynamic binary (static linking, fewer relocations, LTO, trimmed init). Both are pure-Rust and keep one multicall binary. floor_ms and L_delta are 0 because no floor applies."}
